    Before we build

    India settlement,
    explained.

    Start with the operating details, then define the right settlement structure for your business.

    What does INRSettle connect?+

    INRSettle brings INR liquidity, fiat and stablecoin settlement workflows, routing, payment requirements and reconciliation into one infrastructure layer. The exact currencies, providers and settlement responsibilities are agreed for your business during onboarding.

    Can we discuss flows into and out of India?+

    Use the planner to scope an India-linked flow in either direction. Our team reviews the entities, payment purpose, funding currency and destination together to agree the route and operating requirements.

    Does every settlement have to use stablecoins?+

    The settlement design starts with your funding and destination needs. Fiat and digital currency legs can have different operating requirements. We confirm the permitted structure, currencies and responsibilities for your proposed route before execution.

    Which details matter for the India leg?+

    For an Indian bank destination, discussions typically cover beneficiary account and IFSC details, payment purpose and supporting commercial records. The required documents, permitted purpose and available bank rail depend on the route and the relevant provider’s requirements.

    How are cost and delivery time determined?+

    Request a route review for your currency pair and use case. Our team will confirm the funding requirements, FX, fees, limits and delivery windows together before you commit to execution.

    What should we prepare for a first conversation?+

    Your business role, operating jurisdictions, proposed currencies and direction, payment use case and indicative monthly volumes. The route brief brings these points together. Share business information only; bank credentials and sensitive customer records are not needed for an initial inquiry.
